subject.description: The visible primary subject or subjects, including count, appearance, pose, action, clothing, expression, gaze, and relationships.

composition.description: The arrangement of visual elements in the frame, including framing, crop, subject placement, scale, negative space, and foreground, midground, and background organization.

camera.description: Observable viewpoint, camera height, angle, viewing direction, perspective character, and depth of field. Do not infer exact camera, lens, focal length, aperture, or exposure metadata.

scene.description: The visible environment and spatial context, including location type, architecture, background, objects, ground, weather, and relevant surroundings.

lighting.description: Visible light sources, direction, softness, contrast, shadow behavior, ambient fill, backlight, rim light, and reflected light.

appearance.description: Visible physical and surface qualities such as skin, hair, fabric behavior, materials, textures, reflections, and fine details.

color.description: Dominant colors and tonal relationships, including saturation, contrast, white-balance character, and highlight-shadow color relationships.

style.description: A concise observable medium, genre, or visual treatment. Avoid subjective praise and generic quality labels.

location.description: Where the text appears in the image.

presentation.description: Visible typography, color, size, material, or layout when reliably observable. Empty string when unavailable.

notes.description: Visually important information that does not fit another field. Do not repeat information from other fields. Empty string when unnecessary.
